changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 5 item 6: moved TeamMateWorktreeRequest from teammate-collection/types.ts into new worktree/types.ts, closing the request-type half of the named inversion where worktree/manager.ts and worktree/repo-request.ts imported their own request type back from teammate-collection/. teammate-collection/{types,commands,mcp-delegate}.ts and team-collection/types.ts now import it from worktree/types.ts. TeamWorkspaceLoan stays in teammate-collection/types.ts (it has no worktree/-side consumer). worktree/manager.ts's TeamMateSharedWorkspace import and worktree/workspaces.ts's SpawnTeamMateRequest/TeamMateSharedWorkspace imports still cross upward into teammate-collection/ (the result-type half of the inversion); out of this item's scope, left for a later item to decide. No behavior change.
